341:t_2:71.en:
$n
「...All that's left is to do it.」

341:t_2:72.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Nice timing, $n. Your fighting spirit changed the whole mood.」

341:t_2:73.en:
$n
「Until now I've relied on everyone for everything. I've only paid a little of that back.」

341:t_2:74.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I figured you'd be the delicate type by the look of you, but you've got a good smile.」

341:t_2:75.en:
$n
「The smile is thanks to $$ランド$$'s training.」

341:t_2:76.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And your piloting technique is $$セツコ$$'s $$グローリー・スター$$ style, huh?」

341:t_2:78.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Of course. I may not look it, but I've made my living piloting machines.」

341:t_2:79.en:
$$デュオ$$
「What are you talking about!? You could barely eat, what with paying off your debts!」

341:t_2:80.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Stop it, $$デュオ$$. Even sugar water is an important meal for $$クロウ$$.」

341:t_2:82.en:
$n
「Um... you've been through a lot, haven't you, mostly money-wise...」

341:t_2:83.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Thanks for being considerate. ...Not that it's a thank-you, but as your senior in Reactors, I ought to give you something too...」

341:t_2:84.en:
$$デュオ$$
「$n! If you're going to ask him for something, make it something other than money!」

341:t_2:85.en:
$$カレン$$
「Not that asking would do any good - with $$クロウ$$, you could shake him upside down and not even 1 G would fall out!」

341:t_2:88.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No... it's all right. I'm giving you something other than money. ...They're words I was taught when I enlisted in the military.」

341:t_2:89.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Frustration makes a man. Misery makes a man. Sorrow makes a man...」

341:t_2:91.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And a powerful enemy is what truly makes you a great man... Those are the words of an ace from a war long ago.」

341:t_2:92.en:
$n
「You're the second person to teach me that saying.」

341:t_2:93.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Blew it... I try to drop some words of wisdom on a youngster, and someone's already beaten me to it...」

341:t_2:94.en:
$n
「No... thank you. Thanks to you, I feel the strength to keep living welling up in me again.」

341:t_2:95.en:
$$クロウ$$
「By the way, who was the first?」

341:t_2:96.en:
$n
「My father. He taught me survival skills, Jeet Kune Do, and the strength to live.」

341:t_2:97.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Jeet Kune Do, huh... So that's the base of your unit's movements.」

341:t_2:98.en:
$$クロウ$$
「All right... Once things settle down, let's have a match. You against my Systema.」

341:t_2:99.en:
$n
「My old man says there's no way the $$人革連$$'s health calisthenics can beat Jeet Kune Do, the martial art of the whole person... That's what he says.」

341:t_2:100.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Interesting... Let's knock some of the cockiness out of this brash youngster.」

341:t_2:101.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What are you doing, $n and $$クロウ$$ both!? Everyone is already getting ready to sortie!」

341:t_2:103.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Honestly... It's no good saying cool things if your actions don't follow.」

341:t_2:104.en:
$n
「Understood. ...$$クロウ$$... I'm looking forward to our match, you know.」

341:t_2:105.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah. Though first we need to work out how we're getting home.」

341:t_2:106.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Looks like we both have a weakness for older beauties with glasses, $n...)

341:t_2:107.en:
$$クロウ$$
(But Jeet Kune Do, huh... So your old man wanted to train your heart even more than your body...)

341:t_2:108.en:
$$クロウ$$
(I'll be expecting great things. From you, the one $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ entrusted his hope to.)

341:t_3:3.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Hangar ～

341:t_3:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Lieutenant $$ベルファンガン・クルーゾー$$, Master Sergeant $$メリッサ・マオ$$, Sergeant $$クルツ・ウェーバー$$...」

341:t_3:10.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm glad we were able to reunite safely like this.」

341:t_3:11.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「We are as well, Captain.」

341:t_3:12.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You may already know this, but...」

341:t_3:13.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ミスリル$$'s major facilities, starting with $$メリダ島$$, were wiped out in an attack by $$アマルガム$$, which had colluded with $$サイデリアル$$.」

341:t_3:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「After escaping $$メリダ島$$, we broke through the enemy encirclement in the $$ダナン$$ and have been on the run ever since.」

341:t_3:15.en:
$$マオ$$
「And then you were caught up in the $$時空震動$$, is that right?」

341:t_3:16.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... As a result, now that we have a prospect of returning to Earth, it amounts to being rescued from a hopeless predicament.」

341:t_3:17.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's thanks to that $$烙印$$ thing $$ロジャー$$ was talking about, huh.」

341:t_3:18.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no intention of thanking something so uncertain.」

341:t_3:19.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...I'm relieved, Sergeant $$相良$$. That you haven't lost your will to fight, even after $$千鳥かなめ$$ was taken from you.」

341:t_3:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「Ma'am! I have no intention of giving up.」

341:t_3:21.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Then I have one more sad report for you.」

341:t_3:22.en:
$$テッサ$$
「In the battle of $$メリダ島$$, Major $$アンドレイ・セルゲイヴィッチ・カリーニン$$ was classified as MIA.」

341:t_3:24.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Please get an explanation of the battle at $$メリダ島$$ and everything since from Lieutenant Colonel $$マデューカス$$.」

341:t_3:25.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Understood. ...All personnel, we're going straight into the briefing.」

341:t_3:26.en:
$$宗介$$
「My apologies, Lieutenant. Before that, I'd like to go visit $n in the infirmary.」

341:t_3:27.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That guy... he's been unconscious the whole time since he got warped to Mars.」

341:t_3:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「Besides, the $$血塗られた眼$$ has shown up again.」

341:t_3:29.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「...Very well. We'll proceed with the briefing without the Sergeant. You report to me later on how $l is doing.」

341:t_3:32.en:
$$マオ$$
「Are you sure, $$テッサ$$? I'm not saying this is your chance, but don't you want to talk with $$宗介$$ some more?」

341:t_3:33.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Before, when the $$ダナン$$ was about to go off on separate action, I got turned down by $$相良$$.」

341:t_3:35.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But it's all right. I'm the captain of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, and one of the few survivors of $$ミスリル$$.」

341:t_3:36.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So... I'm fine... There are... so many things... I have to do...」

341:t_3:37.en:
$$マオ$$
「...$$テッサ$$... You're going to be one hell of a woman, no doubt about it.」

341:t_3:38.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Oh? You make it sound as if I'm not one now.」

341:t_3:39.en:
$$マオ$$
「...Let's definitely get back to Earth, $$テッサ$$. And once we've blasted $$アマルガム$$, $$サイデリアル$$ and $$バアル$$, then...」

341:t_3:41.en:
$$マオ$$
「Let's laugh from the bottom of our bellies, as hard as we can! Leave it all in the dust!」
